# SI023 — url-not-from-manifest-or-allowlist

Web fetches may only use manifest or policy URLs.

## Why

User-controlled URLs are an SSRF vector: validators must never fetch arbitrary hosts.

## Bad

```python
gl.nondet.web.render(request.args['url'])
```

## Good

```python
gl.nondet.web.render(item['url'])  # validated at filing
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI023 -- reason
```
